name: Red-necked Phalarope
rangeDescription: Holarctic circumpolar; winters at sea in southern hemisphere
description: Fairly small shorebird known for spinning frantically on water to stir up small invertebrates. Note thin, sharp bill.

name: Harris's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Breeds north-central canada; winters to southern usa
description: Large sparrow that is largely restricted to the middle of North America. Breeds in boreal forest and shrubbery in the far north of central Canada, and winters in shrubby or weedy areas in the southern Great Plains.

name: Nazca Booby
rangeDescription: Breeds galapagos and islands off western mexico
description: Large seabird, very similar to Masked Booby. Long and pointy on all ends: wings, tail, and bill.

name: Gray-breasted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (ceará)
description: Highly gregarious small parakeet with a long, pointed tail. Has a chestnut face, a dark cap, a grayish scalloped breast, and a large red patch on the belly.

name: Bamboo Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Lowlands of eastern myanmar, adjacent thailand, northern laos, and malay peninsula
description: Sickly-green bamboo specialist, found in forests with bamboo stands from lowlands up into the hills. Male has a red crown.

name: Guatemalan Flicker
rangeDescription: Highlands of southeastern mexico east of the isthmus of tehuantepec from western chiapas eastward to northwestern nicaragua
description: Large, brownish woodpecker with black barring on the back and black spots on the belly. Easily recognized in flight by its bright white rump.
imageCreditName: Esteban Matías (birding guide) Sierra de los Cuchumatanes Huehuetenango esteban.matias@hotmail.com +502 53810540

name: Northern Jacana
rangeDescription: Inland southern sinaloa and central tamaulipas (northwestern and northeastern mexico); rarely southern texas (where formerly bred) to western panama, and including cozumel (just off yucatán peninsula); and cuba, jamaica, and hispaniola
description: Fancy-looking, vaguely chicken-like bird of freshwater marshes, lakes, and ponds in tropical lowlands, locally in highlands. Walks with high-stepping gait, often on top of floating vegetation (note its very long toes!).

name: Chinese Rubythroat
rangeDescription: Eastern ladakh to northwestern china (gansu), southeastern tibet, and far northern myanmar
description: Handsome male is gray above with a bright red throat, black chest, and white belly. Also note white eyebrows and “moustache” stripe, as well as white panels and edges on a black tail.

name: Anjouan White-eye
rangeDescription: Anjouan island (comoros)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the yellow patches on the throat and undertail and the bold white spectacles around the eye.

name: Bornean Ground-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Borneo
description: Secretive pheasant-like cuckoo that is more often heard than seen; listen for its dove-like “coo-KOO” song and odd sneeze-like call. Beautiful if seen well: iridescent purple-green wings, long dark tail, finely barred underparts, black head, and pale blue-green face and bill.

name: Papuan Parrotfinch
rangeDescription: Mountains of new guinea (bird's head peninsula to southeastern ranges)
description: A rather attractive small finch, mostly pale green with a red tail and a dull bluish-purple face. Found in evergreen forest and forest edge from 1200 to 2600 meters of elevation, rarely lower.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Montane Forest Screech-Owl
rangeDescription: Montane forest of southern bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Medium-sized owl of upland humid forest mixed with Podocarpus and alders on the east slope of the Andes from NW Argentina to central Bolivia. The only Screech-Owl through much of its range.

name: White-fronted Redstart
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (trujillo, táchira, and mérida)
description: An attractive and very active warbler with bright yellow underparts, slate gray upperparts and head, rufous crown, bold white spectacles, and tail highlighted with white. Sexes similar.

name: Sulphur-bellied Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern arizona to costa rica; winters eastern ecuador to northern bolivia
description: Large, streaky flycatcher that sounds remarkably similar to a squeaky toy. Note bold white eyebrow and mustache and bright rufous tail.

name: Scarlet-horned Manakin
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela, western guyana, and far northern brazil
description: Small, chunky bird; males are black with a crested red head. Females are olive-green, paler below, with a short crest.

name: Sao Tome Thrush
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: A large brown thrush with a yellow-tipped dark bill and scaly underparts. The juvenile is flecked buffy above.

name: Ross's Turaco
rangeDescription: Riparian forest and woodland of central africa
description: Spectacular purple turaco with a yellow bill and face and a puffy red crest. Shows large crimson wing patches in flight.

name: Red-capped Coua
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northwestern madagascar
description: Long-tailed, long-legged understory bird with a reddish cap. Found in dry deciduous forest at low elevations in western Madagascar.

name: Stripe-cheeked Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands and foothills on both slopes of panama
description: This scarce small woodpecker is golden-olive above and barred below. The male has a red crown, a red mustache stripe, and a yellow stripe below the eye.

name: Yellow-billed Spoonbill
rangeDescription: Australia; vagrant to tasmania and new zealand
description: Large dull-white bird with a long, spoon-shaped bill. Plumage often appears dirty.
